definitions.full: H4228. machagoreth מַחֲגֹ֫רֶת noun feminine a girding, cincture , only construct; שָׂ֑ק מַחֲגֹרֶת מְּתִיגִּיל תַּחַת Isa 3:24 instead of a mantle a girding of sackcloth .
